Markup-fidelity fixture for the TABLE CARD — the `.pa-table-card` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Table.table_card/1`, svelte `display/TableCard.svelte`). A pa-table-card is a card-like chrome purpose-built to HOST a table: a header (bare title + optional `.pa-table-card__description` subtitle + `.pa-table-card__actions`), a body that holds the table (`.pa-table-card__body`, optionally `--scrollable`), and an optional footer (`.pa-table-card__footer`). SCOPE = the pa-table-card block + the __* elements the component EMITS INLINE (header/title/description/actions/body/footer) + its block modifiers. The inner table is a TEXT slot: the body region's child `.pa-table`/thead/tbody are native consumer markup the component wraps but does not author (styled by DESCENDANT selectors `.pa-table-card__body .pa-table`, NOT via __element classes) — so that table region is CONTAINER-ONLY and its child classes are DEFERRED as prose, exactly as table.json defers thead/tbody and card.json defers its body slot's content. The harness slot carries plain TEXT (the dumper HTML-escapes it), so a real can't flow through; `body` is a bare text token and the diff proves only the body wrapper + header/footer structure. TITLE SHAPE: the blessed title is a BARE heading (

), styled by the `.pa-table-card__header h1..h6` element selector — NOT the deprecated `.pa-table-card__title`/`__title-text` wrapper (snippets/tables.html L308-338). Both wrappers emit the bare

.

propsVocabulary.variant: semantic header colour (primary|success|warning|danger) — tints the header fill. svelte variant; keen variant. NO info/secondary.
propsVocabulary.color: theme-slot header colour (1..9) — pa-table-card--color-{n}. svelte color (number); keen color (string).
propsVocabulary.plain: pa-table-card--plain — strips card chrome (no border/shadow/bg/radius); header/body/footer lose their fills. svelte isPlain; keen is_plain.
propsVocabulary.scrollable: pa-table-card__body--scrollable — enables overflow-x:auto on the body for wide tables. svelte isScrollable; keen is_scrollable.
propsVocabulary.title: header title text — rendered as a BARE <h3> inside the header (blessed shape; the header's h1..h6 element selector styles it). svelte titleText; keen title_text.
propsVocabulary.description: header subtitle — flexes into the free middle of the header row and truncates (pa-table-card__description). svelte descriptionText; keen subtitle_text.
propsVocabulary.actions: header actions slot (buttons/controls), wrapped in pa-table-card__actions. svelte headerActions; keen actions.
propsVocabulary.body: the table region — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (a real <table class="pa-table"> is a native child the consumer writes inside the slot, styled by `.pa-table-card__body .pa-table`, not a sub-component). svelte children; keen inner_block.
propsVocabulary.footer: footer slot (pagination/summary), wrapped in pa-table-card__footer. svelte footer; keen footer.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature.

goldenConventions: Structural only — the table card adds no attribute conventions. Slot content (body/actions/footer) is a plain text token (Body/Actions/Footer) so the diff checks the wrapper's structural nesting, not rich content. The header renders ONLY when a header-ish prop (title/description/actions) is present; the body wrapper ALWAYS renders; the footer renders ONLY when footer is present. Title is a bare <h3> (blessed shape). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. capability.mjs axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to the pa-table-card--* BLOCK modifiers. Real authored block modifiers: --primary/--success/--warning/--danger (one `variant` enum), --color-1..9 (one `color` enum), --plain. The only element modifier is pa-table-card__body--scrollable (verified forward via `scrollable`). title/description/actions/body/footer are structural/slot; extraClass is passthrough. The `.pa-table-card__title`/`__title-text` element classes are DEPRECATED (rc10) and NOT emitted by either wrapper — the blessed title is a bare heading styled by the header's h1..h6 selector — so they are deferred as prose. The inner `.pa-table` + thead/tbody in the body are native consumer markup (deferred).

deferred.//: Element classes acknowledged out-of-scope (prose). The __title/__title-text pair is DEPRECATED (rc10) legacy tolerance — the blessed title is a bare heading (snippets/tables.html L310), so no wrapper emits these. The body's inner table (`.pa-table-card__body .pa-table` + its thead/tbody) is native consumer markup wrapped by the body — it's styled by DESCENDANT selectors, carries no __element classes of this block, and the harness slot carries only plain text so it can't be exercised here (same deferral table.json makes for thead/tbody and card.json makes for body content).
deferred.pa-table-card__title: DEPRECATED (rc10): legacy title wrapper; the blessed title is a bare <h3> styled by the `.pa-table-card__header h1..h6` selector — no wrapper emits this.
deferred.pa-table-card__title-text: DEPRECATED (rc10): legacy title-text span inside __title — see pa-table-card__title.
deferred.pa-table .in .__body: the inner <table class="pa-table"> + its native thead/tbody/tr/th/td are consumer markup written inside the body slot, styled by the `.pa-table-card__body .pa-table` descendant selector — not a child class of this block (see table.json for the pa-table container contract).
